newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE BACK IN HUNT AFTER THRASHING SPURS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE BACK IN HUNT AFTER THRASHING SPURS.

text.p: Newcastle demolished Tottenham 7-1 at St James' Park on Saturday with a superb exhibition of attacking football to end a run of seven English premier league games without a win.

Two goals from Les Ferdinand, Alan Shearer and Robert Lee and one from Philippe Albert gave Kevin Keegan's men their emphatic victory and moved them up to fifth. Allan Nielsen scored Spurs' consolation in the 89th minute.
Liverpool, who play Southampton on Sunday, stayed top on 39 points after second-placed Arsenal were held 2-2 at home by Aston Villa and dropped to third.

Eric Cantona's first half penalty against his former team Leeds gave Manchester United a 1-0 win at Old Trafford and moved the champions into second place. Wimbledon remained fourth after winning 3-1 at Everton.
Manchester United, Arsenal and Wimbledon are all on 37 points followed by Newcastle and Aston Villa on 34.
